from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,shlex,subprocess,time
BASE=Path('/workspace/android-studio-artifacts/import-identity-getters/sdk-runtime')
ROOT=Path('/workspace/android-studio-import-identity-getters')
FIXTURE=BASE/'official-private-project'
EXPECTED=json.loads((BASE.parent/'quality-ownership-cleanup/current-source.json').read_text())
EXCLUDE={'.gradle','.kotlin','build','.koda','.zed'}
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def guard():
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT).decode().strip()==EXPECTED['source_commit']
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','-z'],cwd=ROOT)==b''
    actual={p:sha(ROOT/p) for p in EXPECTED['files']}
    assert actual==EXPECTED['files']
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--stage','-z'],cwd=ROOT).hex()==EXPECTED['index_hex']
    return actual

def manifest():
    values={}
    for directory,dirs,files in os.walk(FIXTURE):
        dirs[:]=[name for name in dirs if name not in EXCLUDE]
        for name in files:
            p=Path(directory)/name
            if p.is_file():values[str(p.relative_to(FIXTURE))]={'sha256':sha(p),'bytes':p.stat().st_size}
    return values

def run(label,exporter,tasks,unsupported=False):
    before=guard();inputs=manifest();directory=BASE/label;directory.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    (directory/'private-inputs-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(inputs,indent=2)+'\n')
    command=[str(FIXTURE/'gradlew'),'--init-script',str(BASE/exporter),*tasks,'--no-configuration-cache','--console=plain','--no-daemon']
    start=time.monotonic()
    shell='source /workspace/android-studio-artifacts/android-env.sh\nsource /workspace/android-studio-artifacts/jdk21-env.sh\n'+shlex.join(command)
    with (directory/'stdout.log').open('xb') as out,(directory/'stderr.log').open('xb') as err:
        result=subprocess.run(['bash','-lc',shell],cwd=FIXTURE,stdout=out,stderr=err)
    after=guard();after_inputs=manifest()
    receipt={'source_commit':EXPECTED['source_commit'],'command':command,'exit_code':result.returncode,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'stdout_sha256':sha(directory/'stdout.log'),'stderr_sha256':sha(directory/'stderr.log'),'whole_source_count':len(before),'whole_source_and_index_unchanged':before==after,'private_inputs_unchanged':inputs==after_inputs,'supplementary_environment_only':True,'canonical_original_test_credit':0,'expected_unsupported':unsupported}
    (directory/'private-inputs-after.json').write_text(json.dumps(after_inputs,indent=2)+'\n')
    (directory/'exit.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
    assert before==after and inputs==after_inputs,receipt
    stdout=(directory/'stdout.log').read_text();stderr=(directory/'stderr.log').read_text()
    records=[line[len('KODA_ANDROID_PROJECT_MODEL='):] for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('KODA_ANDROID_PROJECT_MODEL=')]
    if unsupported:
        assert result.returncode!=0 and not records,receipt
        assert 'does not yet support included builds' in stdout+stderr
        print(json.dumps({'stage':label,'actual_supported':False,'explicit_existing_guard_verified':True,'exit':result.returncode}),flush=True)
        return None
    assert result.returncode==0 and len(records)==1,receipt
    record=json.loads(records[0]);(directory/'complete-record.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
    receipt.update(model_record_bytes=len(records[0].encode()),decoder_record_boundary_bytes=16*1024*1024,model_record_under_existing_boundary=len(records[0].encode())<=16*1024*1024)
    (directory/'verified.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'stage':label,'exit':0,'record_bytes':receipt['model_record_bytes'],'elapsed_seconds':receipt['elapsed_seconds']}),flush=True)
    return record

def pair(scenario,tasks):
    old=run(scenario+'-old','old-official-export.gradle',tasks)
    new=run(scenario+'-current','current-official-export.gradle',tasks)
    projected=dict(new);sidecar=projected.pop('importFacts')
    assert projected==old, 'Full old envelope projection changed in '+scenario
    assert list(projected)==list(old), 'Top-level envelope field order changed'
    assert json.dumps(projected,separators=(',',':'))==json.dumps(old,separators=(',',':')), 'Full nested property/vector order changed'
    command=[str(BASE/'runtime-probe'),str(FIXTURE),str(BASE/(scenario+'-current')/'stdout.log'),scenario]
    t=time.monotonic();result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    (BASE/(scenario+'-current')/'rust-probe.stdout.log').write_bytes(result.stdout)
    (BASE/(scenario+'-current')/'rust-probe.stderr.log').write_bytes(result.stderr)
    evidence={'source_commit':EXPECTED['source_commit'],'scenario':scenario,'full_legacy_basic_and_v2_projection_exact':True,'all_envelope_values_properties_vector_order_preserved':True,'normalization':'none; same private project path for old and current','old_envelope_projection_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(old,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest(),'new_envelope_projection_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(projected,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest(),'raw_identity_record_retained':True,'command':command,'rust_probe_exit':result.returncode,'rust_probe_elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-t,'rust_probe_stdout_sha256':hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(),'rust_probe_stderr_sha256':hashlib.sha256(result.stderr).hexdigest(),'canonical_original_test_credit':0}
    (BASE/(scenario+'-projection-and-decoder.json')).write_text(json.dumps(evidence,indent=2)+'\n')
    assert result.returncode==0, result.stderr.decode()
    guard();print(json.dumps({'scenario':scenario,'full_legacy_and_v2_projection':'PASS','normal_current_source_Rust_decoder_and_oracle':'PASS','original_test_credit':0}),flush=True)

guard()
pair('baseline',['kodaAndroidProjectModel'])
settings=FIXTURE/'settings.gradle.kts'
settings.write_text(settings.read_text()+\
    '\nrootProject.name = "Explicit Identity Root"\ninclude(":left:shared", ":right:shared")\nproject(":left:shared").projectDir = file("jvm-one")\nproject(":right:shared").projectDir = file("jvm-two")\n')
for name in ['left','right']:(FIXTURE/name).mkdir()
for name in ['jvm-one','jvm-two']:
    directory=FIXTURE/name;directory.mkdir()
    (directory/'build.gradle').write_text("plugins { id 'java-library'; id 'idea' }\nidea.module.name = 'shared-collision'\n")
pair('nested',['kodaAndroidProjectModel'])
fixture=ROOT/'crates/android_tools/test_data/import_facts/late_configuration.gradle'
(FIXTURE/'jvm-one'/'late_configuration.gradle').write_bytes(fixture.read_bytes())
build=FIXTURE/'jvm-one'/'build.gradle';build.write_text(build.read_text()+"apply from: 'late_configuration.gradle'\n")
pair('late',['kodaAndroidProjectModel',':left:shared:kodaIdentityOracle'])
included=FIXTURE/'included-identity-build';included.mkdir()
(included/'settings.gradle.kts').write_text('rootProject.name = "Included Identity"\n')
(included/'build.gradle').write_text("plugins { id 'java-library' }\n")
settings.write_text(settings.read_text()+'\nincludeBuild("included-identity-build")\n')
for label,exporter in [('included-old','old-official-export.gradle'),('included-current','current-official-export.gradle')]:
    run(label,exporter,['kodaAndroidProjectModel'],unsupported=True)
guard()
summary={'source_commit':EXPECTED['source_commit'],'source_files':len(EXPECTED['files']),'actual_capture_count':8,'actual_supported_scenario_pairs':['baseline','nested','late'],'actual_included_build_guard_rejections':2,'whole_source_index_unchanged':True,'complete_basic_v2_projections_preserved':True,'actual_rust_identity_decoding_and_late_official_oracle_pass':True,'source_only_original_runtime_test_credit':0,'non_rust_exception':'official Gradle/AGP model runtime and public getters; serialization-only minimal bridge; all identity policy remains Rust'}
(BASE/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2),flush=True)
